description: This file defines a PHP class 'View' in the SuiteCRM administration search module. It extends an abstract view class and implements methods for rendering the search settings interface, including pre-display setup and the display logic that assigns variables to a Smarty template for rendering the search configuration page.

classes.name: View
classes.description: A class that renders the search settings page in the SuiteCRM administration interface, handling the setup of available search engines and modules, and displaying the configuration template.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the View object and calls the parent constructor with the path to the view template.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares data for the display, including assigning selected controller and engine, and merging legacy search engines with current engines.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Assigns language strings and module data to Smarty variables and renders the search settings template.
